select a.id as id, a.calculate_date as calculateDate, a.contract_id as contractId, a.contract_start_date as contractStartDate, a.confirm_income_this_year as confirmIncomeThisYear, a.calculate_interest_this_year as calculateInterestThisYear, a.operating_income as operatingIncome, a.ftp_interest as ftpInterest, a.risk_balance_end_of_last_year as riskBalanceEndOfLastYear, a.risk_balance_end_of_this_year as riskBalanceEndOfThisYear, a.additional_tax as additionalTax, a.profit as profit, a.profit_exclude_fee as profitExcludeFee, a.remaining_principle_end_of_this_year as remainingPrincipleEndOfThisYear, a.remaining_earnest_end_of_this_year as remainingEarnestEndOfThisYear, b.contract_code as contractCode, b.biz_dept_id as bizDeptId, b.client_id as clientId, b.biz_type as bizType, b.lease_type as leaseType, b.factoring_type as factoringType, b.zr_type as zrType, c.client_name as clientName, d.risk_control_industry_classify as riskControlIndustryClassify, e.name as bizDeptName from profit_calculate_result as a left join contract_base_info as b on a.contract_id = b.id left join client as c on a.contract_id = c.id left join corp_commerce_info_lib as d on c.id = d.client_id and c.newest_version = d.version left join bifrost_org e on e.id = b.biz_dept_id
limit #{query.start}, #{query.size}
